      Why Every Man’s Wardrobe Must Have a Tuxedo Shirt?

      byHaresh MoorjanionFeb 01, 2026

      For life’s most memorable evenings, nothing matches the quiet authority of a tuxedo shirt. Rooted in the rich legacy of black-tie dressing, it remains the cornerstone of refined formalwear—crisp, elegant, and impeccably crafted. From weddings and celebrations to gala nights and black-tie banquets, a well-made tuxedo shirt elevates every moment with timeless sophistication. With ZOD! Club Wear’s expertly tailored designs in superfine cotton, classic detailing meets modern precision—ensuring you don’t just dress for the occasion, but rise to it.

Building a well-rounded collection of white shirts isn’t indulgence—it’s the foundation of a wardrobe that’s always prepared, always polished, and always in style.

      Why Linen Shirts Are Essential for Every Man's Wardrobe

      byHaresh MoorjanionJan 28, 2026

      Breathable, timeless, and effortlessly refined, linen has long been a cornerstone of men’s summer dressing. Woven from natural flax fibres, it allows air to circulate freely, keeping you cool and comfortable even in the most humid conditions. Naturally sustainable and built to last, linen softens with wear while retaining its strength—making it as responsible as it is stylish. ZODIAC elevates this classic with premium linen sourced from Normandy, France, reimagined in the 2024 Positano Pure Linen Collection. Inspired by the sun-washed hues of the Amalfi Coast, these versatile shirts move seamlessly from relaxed daytime looks to elegant summer evenings—proving that true style is both enduring and effortless.

      Corduroy Shirts: Staying Alive Through The Ages

      byHaresh MoorjanionJan 28, 2026

      Steeped in history and rich in character, corduroy has journeyed from royal courts to contemporary wardrobes with effortless ease. Once favoured by aristocracy and later embraced for its durability, this textured fabric has evolved into a modern style essential. Today’s corduroy shirts strike the perfect balance between vintage charm and contemporary versatility—offering depth, warmth, and understated sophistication. Reimagined through z3’s “Velvet Touch” corduroys, crafted in 100% cotton and finished for exceptional comfort, corduroy proves once again that true classics don’t fade—they adapt, endure, and return stronger with time.

      Warm Weather Essentials for Every Man's Wardrobe

      byHaresh MoorjanionJan 28, 2026

      Indian summers are relentless, with soaring temperatures that demand smarter wardrobe choices. When the heat peaks, breathability becomes non-negotiable—making natural fabrics like cotton and linen the true heroes of summer dressing. Lightweight, moisture-absorbing, and cooling by nature, these fabrics help regulate body temperature while keeping you comfortable through long, sun-soaked days. The House of ZODIAC curates summer essentials in the finest cottons and premium European linen, complemented by z3’s eco-conscious casuals in breathable weaves and fresh colours. Designed to beat the heat without compromising on style, these pieces make summer dressing effortless, refined, and refreshingly comfortable.

      Friday Dressing Reinvented

      byHaresh MoorjanionJan 28, 2026

      Born in the ’90s, Friday Dressing was about easing out of rigid formals and stepping straight into the weekend. Today, as workwear evolves to reflect individuality rather than uniformity, this ritual has been reimagined for a new generation. The House of ZODIAC brings together design-led collections that celebrate every mood, moment, and personality—from classic to casual to unapologetically bold. Whether it’s the refined elegance of Vivace in premium Egyptian cotton, the easy sophistication of Positano Linen, the relaxed luxury of z3 casuals, or the statement-making edge of ZOD! Club Wear, Friday Dressing now means dressing your way—day to night, work to weekend, effortlessly.

      What ZODIAC Is Doing For A Greener Tomorrow

      byHaresh MoorjanionJan 28, 2026

      ZODIAC’s LEED Gold Certified corporate headquarters stands as a benchmark in sustainable design and responsible manufacturing. Certified under the LEED India New Construction rating system, the thoughtfully renovated workspace reflects the brand’s 61-year legacy of excellence while embracing energy efficiency, smart infrastructure, and eco-conscious innovation. From green rooftops and natural ventilation to water-saving systems and low-impact materials, the building uses 60% less energy than a conventional office of its size -underscoring ZODIAC’s commitment to reducing its environmental footprint and shaping a future where fashion and sustainability coexist seamlessly.
